Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

Great question! Here's how our international shipping works:

US Shipping: ✅ We ship throughout the U.S.

Canada: ✅ We can ship to Canada for $25. Please note that orders shipped to Canada may be subject to import taxes, customs/duties, and other fees that are not included in the checkout total. These charges would be the customer's responsibility and are typically collected upon delivery.

Other Countries: We're currently unable to ship internationally from our warehouse beyond the US and Canada. I'd recommend checking Amazon to see if they can deliver our products to your area! We're always working on expanding our options for international customers, especially on Amazon.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?

Happy to explain our warranty! 😊

Simple Modern Limited Lifetime Warranty

We stand behind our products — if something goes wrong due to a manufacturing defect, we'll make it right.

What's Covered:

Broken Lids: Leaking when fully closed or won't thread properly
Insulation Failure: Condensation appearing around the middle of the vessel after filling with ice water for ~2 hours
Textile Products (bags, totes, coolers, lunch bags): Ripped stitching, broken zippers/clips, or detached handles upon arrival (normal wear after one year is not covered)
Plastic or Silicone Parts: Warped, unattached, or non-functioning components
Shipping Damage: Items that arrive dented, scratched, or damaged (must be reported before use)

What's NOT Covered:

Normal wear and tear (scratches, dents, chips, fading)
Damage from drops, misuse, improper cleaning, or modifications
Mold, odors, or taste issues from use/storage
Counterfeit products or unauthorized sellers
